title: Fix 4 Windows-only test failures (issue #94): glob-char stat errno + fixture path canonicalization
action: In hooks/write_guard/jspath.rs io_err_is_enoent (lines ~402-411), widen the cfg!(windows) arm to also match raw_os_error 123 (ERROR_INVALID_NAME) and 161 (ERROR_BAD_PATHNAME) so a stat on a literal glob token like *.log is classified not-found and walk_existing_ancestor climbs to the parent, matching POSIX behavior. In verbs/reservations/tests.rs worktree_fixture (~558-581) and verbs/cells/tests.rs wf_worktree_fixture (~4644-4667), canonicalize the tempdir root with dunce::canonicalize before any git init/worktree add or path join, following the build_fixture precedent in hooks/write_guard/tests.rs:54-64, so Windows 8.3 short paths (RUNNER~1) never enter byte-equality checks. Do NOT change production path-equality semantics in store.rs or hook_local.rs.
goal: Windows CI verify green: the 4 red tests (bash_plain_glob_target_behaves_exactly_as_before_d4, bash_plain_glob_write_outside_scratch_shape_allows_as_before_d4, claim_annotation_names_the_granted_worktree_root, grant_key_linked_id_and_guard_workspace_id_are_one_string) pass on windows-latest; Linux suite stays green.
notes: Windows-only red; local run is Linux so full proof lands on Windows CI after push.
judge_obligation_ack: guard diff is a 2-errno widening mirroring POSIX ENOENT semantics; an independent bee-review read over the guard diff runs before merge
